title: Rabbi Avin the Carpenter
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Shabbat 23b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.23b.4) relates that Rav Huna used to pass by Rabbi Avin the carpenter’s doorway and teach there. Seeing that the household regularly lit many lamps (in honor of Shabbat), he said: “Two great men will emerge from here.” Rav Idi and Rav Chiyya emerged from that household; see their entries. Hyman cites [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=160&lang=en) for “Rabbi Bin bar Nagri” at the beginning of chapter 7 of [Midrash Shmuel](https://www.sefaria.org/Midrash_Shmuel.27.1). He proposes Rabbi Aivu bar Nagri, as explained in his entry. See also [Heilprin’s entry on Aivu](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=390&lang=en).[^1]

notes.text: The Bavli names Rav Idi bar Avin and Rav Chiyya bar Avin. Heilprin places the midrash citation at the start of chapter 27 and writes Bon. The linked edition of Midrash Shmuel gives “Rabbi ben Nagri” in parentheses and “Rabbi Ayvi bar Nagri” in brackets. Hyman cites chapter 7 and proposes Aivu; those are his locator and reading.
